verdict: Abandoned before setup: the local dev server never finished compiling. The read-only warm-up that worked for round102 (root 369 s) exceeded 600 s this time, and after the warm-up was stopped a plain GET on the root and on the game route still returned nothing in 90 s. No room, no player intent, zero model calls, zero private captures, CNY 0; services stopped, 389 source files unchanged. Nothing about the source under test was exercised. The batch harness change this round carried (client abort 120 s -> 240 s, spend limits untouched) is therefore also unexercised.
